purpose: Bare D3D11 allocation check for an explicit Windowed=true fullscreen descriptor versus the existing NULL descriptor.
profile: debug probe, 10 steady frames plus existing resize/idle sequence; both variants use identical shortened fixture.

initial_attempt.outcome: Cancelled the control during background presentation waits before any summary was produced. No measurements used. Both variants were then rebuilt with 10 frames.

conclusion: No allocation improvement is observed. Do not integrate the constructor change.
limits: One focused debug pair, not an Editor benchmark or performance scoreboard.
CPU and timing figures are invalid for performance claims with this short, background-waiting probe.
This does not establish general memory equivalence on all DXGI drivers.
